evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Never framed: 'we have availability within your time frame, this will take 10-15 minutes, you can walk away with a quote you can depend on.' Rep dove directly into details.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' Rep proceeded straight to logistics.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gave hourly rate ($330) and crew size (3 movers) but no typical range for a home this size or personalization to customer's move beyond 'given the information you gave me.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full disclosure: '$75 trip fee that includes everything. So there's no hidden fees... it's just that flat rate... you only pay for the time you use.' Missing: no explicit 2.5-hour minimum or 15-minute-increments commitment framing stated.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asked 'Does that feel fair?' or equivalent. Moved directly to estimate details and truck availability.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asked 'did you have any other questions for me' — throwaway phrasing, not 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: No ask. Rep said 'if you're ready to rock and roll I can go ahead and book that truck' — conditional phrasing, not a plain 'Would you like our help with your move?' and the customer agreed implicitly by asking for confirmation email, but rep never explicitly asked.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Date (October 9th), arrival window (8:00–8:30 AM), crew size (3 movers), phone/email (james.a.more.ATX@gmail.com), addresses implied but not explicitly re-confirmed. Notes about customer concerns (fragile items, packing) mentioned but not explicitly noted for crew.

top_strength: Rep managed a complex multi-floor building move (31st to 28th floor) with packing services and clearly explained the all-inclusive pricing structure, trip fee, hourly rate, and no-hidden-fees framing without confusion.
coaching_note: This call skipped the two foundational moments: the opening quid pro quo (no time-box or dependable-quote promise) and their agenda (no early ask about concerns beyond price), and never delivered the Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage), which are non-negotiable close elements — rebuild those sections into your opener and pre-close flow.
